01 / A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE
LIFE FIRST. MONEY SECOND.

Money is a tool.
Your life is the point.

Moneytec brings the conversation back to you. What matters. What’s possible. And what a thoughtful next step could look like.

A FEW THINGS WORTH KNOWING

Good questions.
Clearer answers.

What does Moneytec mean?+

Money + technology. This concept brings a clear, human perspective to personal finance, using simple tools to make planning feel more approachable.

Can I invest or open an account here?+

This is a website and brand concept with educational tools. It does not open accounts, accept investments, execute transactions or provide regulated financial advice. Any future services and eligibility will be described before they become available.

Are the calculator results guaranteed?+

No. The results use your assumptions and a simplified monthly compounding model. Actual returns vary, can be negative, and are affected by fees, taxes and market conditions.

Where do my numbers go?+

Calculations happen in your browser. Your entries are not submitted to a server, and downloading a plan creates a text file on your device.
